into_hole.label: Into the hole
into_hole.note: The bag hung on the lip for 0.78 s, then dropped through the hole. It shrank from view as it tipped in.

model_note: Drag-free fit misses the measured path by 10.2 px RMS; predicting the second half from the first half misses by 36.9 px RMS. The bag slows horizontally in the image (8% of its vertical acceleration). Drag and the bag moving away from the camera both cause this; one camera cannot separate them.
